stories.title: Leaf fall timetable: what changes on the Wrexham to Bidston line from Saturday
stories.summary: Most trains on the Wrexham to Bidston line will stop running to Wrexham Central from Saturday under a temporary autumn timetable. stories.title: ADHD and autism at growing risk of overdiagnosis, review warns
stories.summary: The risk of ADHD and autism being overdiagnosed or misdiagnosed is growing, a review for the UK Government has said, but it could not conclude this is happening at scale. stories.title: John Summers Clock Tower to open for tours on Saturday to mark 130 years of Shotton steelworks
stories.summary: The John Summers Clock Tower at the former Shotton steelworks will open to the public on Saturday (10 October) to mark 130 years since the works opened. stories.title: UK Government letter to Uniper asks if Connah’s Quay power station plan does enough for Dee Estuary wildlife
stories.summary: The UK Government has written to Uniper asking whether its plans would make up for the saltmarsh and curlew habitat that would be lost to a new power station at Connah’s Quay.
